endpoints.description: Creates a tuning job and returns its initial state.
notes: Only the fields listed here are accepted; unsupported fields are rejected.
mode accepts quick, standard, deep or power_save.
Idempotency-Key is required and an exact retry replays the original response while reuse for a different request is rejected.
A transient lifecycle conflict is reported before dispatch and does not consume the key.

endpoints.description: Rolls the active tuning state back.
notes: The request body must be empty or an empty JSON object.
Idempotency-Key is required and an exact retry replays the original response while reuse for a different request is rejected.

endpoints.description: Read-only state of one tuning job.
notes: {jobId} is a literal placeholder: substitute a real job id, which may contain letters, digits, dot, underscore, colon or hyphen.
Reads through the runtime coordinator and does not use the generation busy gate, so it stays available while a candidate is loading or being recovered.
The single segment `current` selects the current job.

endpoints.description: Applies a pause, resume, cancel or apply transition to one tuning job.
notes: {jobId} is a literal placeholder: substitute a real job id, which may contain letters, digits, dot, underscore, colon or hyphen.
The router also accepts a two-segment form /v1/tuning/jobs/{jobId}/{action} where action is pause, resume, cancel or apply; no other action is accepted.
The body must be empty or an empty JSON object.
`current` is rejected here: a transition needs a concrete job id.
Idempotency-Key is required and an exact retry replays the original response while reuse for a different request is rejected.

endpoints.description: Runtime agent recommendation for the posted request body.
notes: The response payload is produced by the runtime-registered advisor provider; this module forwards the body and returns that JSON, so it cannot guarantee the response shape.
A recommendation is advisory and never an admission gate for any route.

endpoints.description: Runtime benchmark result for the posted request body.
